rules.content:
/*
Werewolves ransomware (LockBit 3.0 variant)
*/

rule Werewolves_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.werewolves"
        description = "Detects Werewolves ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "Werewolves" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "WEREWOLVES" ascii
        $s3 = "werewolves.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
